## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run type-check`
- [ ] `npm run test:run`
- [ ] `npm run build`

## Security checklist

- [ ] Auth checks are intact for sensitive operations.
- [ ] Input validation covers new/changed mutation paths.
- [ ] No secrets were added.
- [ ] RLS impact reviewed (if DB/API touched).

## Notes for reviewers

Call out risky areas, migration requirements, or rollout concerns.
